传到雪球图床后按顺序附在文末: Uploaded to Xueqiu image hosting and appended at the end of the post in order
先传到雪球图床再嵌进正文，按顺序附在文末: Uploaded to Xueqiu image hosting first, then embedded in the body and appended at the end in order
内容经 LLM 改写/生成过就该打开——这是雪球的合规字段，不是可选项: Turn this on whenever the content was rewritten or generated by an LLM — this is a Xueqiu compliance field, not optional
写长文（存草稿）: Write a long post (save as draft)
发一条雪球帖子，可带图。正文给纯文本或 markdown 皆可，插件转成雪球的: Publishes a Xueqiu post, optionally with images. The body can be plain text or markdown; the plugin converts it to Xueqiu HTML
发帖接口要的防重放串。**留空则插件自己去页面上取**；取不到时会在错误里让你手: The anti-replay string required by the posting API. **Leave blank and the plugin will fetch it from the page itself**; if it cannot, the error will ask you to paste it manually (F12 → Network → publish a post → `session_token` in the request body)
已经在雪球图床上的地址；留空则没有封面: A URL already on Xueqiu image hosting; leave blank for no cover image
打开它检查排版，确认无误再点发布: Open it to check the formatting, then click publish once it looks right
把一篇长文写进雪球草稿箱，可带图；**不会直接发布**，最后一步在网页上点: Saves a long post into the Xueqiu draft box, optionally with images; **it will not publish directly** — the last step is done on the web page
拼不出时为空，不是错误: Empty when it cannot be constructed; this is not an error
浏览器里登录雪球后，F12 → Network → 任意请求 → 复制整条 Co: Log in to Xueqiu in your browser, then F12 → Network → any request → copy the full Cookie value and paste it here. It must at least include xq_a_token / xqat / xq_id_token / u / device_id
留空用一个常见的桌面 Chrome UA。与你取 cookie 的浏览器保持一致: Leave blank to use a common desktop Chrome UA. Matching the browser you took the cookie from is more reliable
纯文本/简单 markdown（**加粗**、空行分段）。已经是 HTML 的话: Plain text or simple markdown (**bold**, blank-line paragraphs). If it is already HTML, it is passed through unchanged
网页请求 URL 上挂的那串。**先留空试**——多数情况下不带也能发；若报风控: The string attached to the web request URL. **Try leaving it blank first** — in most cases posting works without it; if you get a risk-control error or 403, paste the full value from your browser
读一次写作页判断登录态（无副作用），顺带带出 uid 与昵称。ok=false: Reads the compose page once to check login status (no side effects), and also returns the uid and nickname. ok=false means the cookie has expired
部署环境直连不了 xueqiu.com 时填: Fill in when the deployment environment cannot reach xueqiu.com directly
